description:

* The checklist as data (`backend/anvil/skills/cra-review/annex1.yaml`) for claude's skill (ANVIL-20).
* The RTEMS ticket text (no `anvil` label).

## Acceptance

Spec merged after claude's review; checklist file present; RTEMS ticket created.
